semantic_findings: chosen is DISTINCT ON(record_key); JSONB objects contain one value per field key. The materialized chosen_fields left join therefore contributes at most one match per vote and does not multiply candidate counts.
A missing key produces SQL NULL on both paths and invokes the existing fallback. A present JSON null stays a JSONB null value and does not invoke COALESCE fallback.

The votes, candidate/version counts, version selection, deterministic row ordering, conflict ordering, date cleanup, record output, ON CONFLICT update and complete link-refresh statements are unchanged.
The candidate adds no callable surface, grants, roles, settings, schedule, persistent index/table, authentication path, lease/fence change or accounting bypass.

qualification_review.covered: Six missing/null field-aggregation cases; actual single/multiple/null/tied provider versions and rare field conflicts; complete shared record/link/source/count/receipt snapshots; real follow-on page; same function metadata/OID; exact 1000-row full tuples at 711481 source bytes; normal and forced-generic plan work.
qualification_review.snapshot_limit: The inherited snapshot covers eleven shared/projection/page/readback tables. It is not a separately asserted snapshot of every run/task accounting table.

performance_tradeoff.interpretation: Materializing chosen fields replaces repeated JSONB extraction with additional intermediate rows and spill. Local warm timing improves in this fixture, while higher temporary I/O is a real tradeoff. No production latency ratio or whole-cron recovery is established.

read_only_probe_review.limitations: Current projected after-state only, separate snapshot/cache state, direct role/dynamic plan, and no original write/trigger or exclusive phase-cost reproduction.

recommendation: No blocker to the bounded candidate-only read or continued guarded-forward/restore preparation. Final activation still requires review of exact wrapper/test bytes, publication and required exact-head CI, fresh ownership/source reconciliation and root-only application/readback. Do not replay the original baseline probe merely for a latency ratio.
